segments.text:
V. 44.
For ye are as graves which appear not—P〈7 letters〉, i• ſpeaking this our LORD fixed his Eyes on the Scribes. As 〈…〉
appear not, being over-grown with Graſs, ſo that men are not aware, till they ſtumble upon them, and either hurt themſelves, or at leaſt are defiled by touching them. On another Occaſion Chriſt compared them to whited ſepulchres, fair without, but foul within, Mat. xxiii. 27.
